name: XLA_DISTRIBUTION_LINKS
description: This table contains the link between transactions and subledger journal entry lines.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the categorization of accounting events that is unique within an application and event class.

columns.name: AE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Subledger journal entry identifier.

columns.name: AE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Subledger journal entry line number.

columns.name: APPLIED_DESCRIPTION_PRIORITY
columns.description: Rule priority of the successfully evaluated description rule that was used to create the journal line description.

columns.name: APPLIED_ACCOUNT_PRIORITIES
columns.description: Concatenated rule priority of the successfully evaluated account and segment rules that were used to derive the GL account.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_TYPE
columns.description: Classification of transaction source distribution.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_CHAR_1
columns.description: Flexible source distribution identifier (Character).

columns.description: Flexible source distribution identifier (Character).

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_CHAR_5

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_NUM_1
columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier (Number).

columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier (Number).

columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier (Number).

columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier (Number).

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_NUM_5
columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier (Number).

columns.name: TAX_LINE_REF_ID
columns.description: Identifier of detail tax line reference.

columns.name: TAX_SUMMARY_LINE_REF_ID
columns.description: Identifier of summary tax line reference.

columns.name: TAX_REC_NREC_DIST_REF_ID
columns.description: Detail tax distribution  reference.

columns.name: STATISTICAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount entered in a journal that is based on the unit of measure.

columns.name: REF_AE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Reversed subledger journal entry  header identifier.

columns.name: REF_TEMP_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Temporary line number reference.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of a rule to convert transactional data into a journal entry line.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of journal line rule: Debit, Credit, Gain or Loss.

columns.name: MERGE_DUPLICATE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates how duplicate subledger journal lines are merged. Possible values are: A: Merge all lines. W: All matching debit lines will be merged and all matching credit lines will be merged to             produce a single debit, single credit, or both a single debit and credit line. N: Do not merge matching lines.

columns.name: TEMP_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Intermediary line number generated by the accounting engine when the entries are in most detail form.

columns.name: REF_EVENT_ID
columns.description: In a reversal row, indicates the event identifier from the actual reversed subledger journal entry line. Otherwise, the value is Null.

columns.name: LINE_DEFINITION_OWNER_CODE
columns.description: Journal lines definition owner code.

columns.name: LINE_DEFINITION_CODE
columns.description: Short name of a subledger journal entry line definition.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event class and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event type and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: UPG_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of upgrade batch.

columns.name: CALCULATE_ACCTD_AMTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the accounted amounts are calculated by Subledger Accounting or passed through transaction objects.  Y  indicates that accounted amounts are calculated by the accounting program. N indicates that accounted amounts were passed through the extract.

columns.name: CALCULATE_G_L_AMTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the gain or loss amounts are calculated by the accounting engine. Y indicates that gain or loss amounts are calculated by the accounting program. N indicates that gain or loss amounts were passed through the extract.

columns.name: ROUNDING_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Accounting class associated to the journal line. It is used as the grouping criteria for rounding. Accounting Program uses this field and the DOCUMENT_ROUNDING_LEVEL together to group lines together to perform rounding.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ROUNDING_LEVEL
columns.description: Indicates the document identifier for which the accounting engine must perform the rounding. Accounting Program uses this field and the rounding_class_code together to group lines together to perform rounding.

columns.name: UNROUNDED_ENTERED_DR
columns.description: Unrounded entered debit amount for the journal line.

columns.name: UNROUNDED_ENTERED_CR
columns.description: Unrounded entered credit amount for the journal line.

columns.name: DOC_ROUNDING_ENTERED_AMT
columns.description: Unrounded accounted debit.

columns.name: DOC_ROUNDING_ACCTD_AMT
columns.description: Rounding amount for accounted amount calculated by the accounting engine for the document.

columns.name: UNROUNDED_ACCOUNTED_CR
columns.description: Unrounded accounted credit for journal entry line.

columns.name: UNROUNDED_ACCOUNTED_DR
columns.description: Unrounded accounted debit for journal entry line.

columns.name: GAIN_OR_LOSS_REF
columns.description: Contains the source value of the Gain or Loss Reference accounting attribute used to add journal lines in gain or loss amount calculation.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REF_AE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Reference accounting line number.

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID

columns.name: LEGAL_TAX_REPORTING_STATUS

columns.name: MPA_COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether multiperiod accounting is complete for the distribution. Possible values are; Y, multiperiod accounting is complete, and N, multiperiod accounting is not complete.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period that contains the accounting entry.

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping information, when combined with the period, determines the database partition in which this journal link information will be stored.
